name: arithmetic and interpolation
source:
Let count be 2.
Say "count={count}; total={count plus 3}.".

name: branch and loop
source:
Let total be 0.
Repeat 3 times:
    Set total to total plus the current repetition number.
End repeat.
If total is equal to 6:
    Say "ok".
Otherwise:
    Say "bad".
End if.

name: function and collection
source:
To double with value:
    Give back value times 2.
End function.
Let values be [2, 4].
Say double(values[1]).

name: dictionary literal and slice
source:
Let profile be {"answer": 42}.
Let values be [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].
Say profile["answer"].
Say values[1:4:2].
Say values[::-1].

name: unicode text slicing
source: Say "héllo"[1:3].

name: class constructor fields and methods
source:
Create a class called Animal:
    When creating an Animal with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To speak:
        Say "{this.name} makes a sound.".
    End function.
    To greet with greeting:
        Say "{greeting}, {this.name}.".
    End function.
End class.
Let dog be a new Animal with "Max".
Tell dog to speak.
Tell dog to greet with "Hello".
output:
Max makes a sound.
Hello, Max.

name: class inheritance and overriding
source:
Create a class called Animal:
    When creating an Animal with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To speak:
        Say "{this.name} makes a sound.".
    End function.
End class.
Create a class called Dog based on Animal:
    To speak:
        Say "Woof, {this.name}!".
    End function.
    To greet with prefix:
        Say "{prefix} {this.name}.".
    End function.
End class.
Let pet be a new Dog with "Rex".
Set pet.name to "Rexy".
Tell pet to speak.
Tell pet to greet with "Pet:".

name: class type inspection
source:
Create a class called Box:
End class.
Let box be a new Box.
Say type_of(Box).
Say type_of(box).

name: local module import and cache
source:
Use the module "math_helpers.tell" as helpers.
Use the module "math_helpers.tell" as helper_copy.
Say helpers.triple(7).
Say helper_copy.triple(3).

name: expression precedence and short circuit
source:
If 2 plus 3 times 4 is equal to 14:
    Say "precedence ok".
End if.
If false and (1 divided by 0 is equal to 0):
    Say "bad and".
Otherwise:
    Say "and short-circuited".
End if.
If true or (1 divided by 0 is equal to 0):
    Say "or short-circuited".
End if.
If 2 to the power of 3 to the power of 2 is equal to 512:
    Say "right associative".
End if.
If 1.5e2 plus 1e1 is equal to 160:
    Say "scientific notation".
End if.
output:
precedence ok
and short-circuited
or short-circuited
right associative
scientific notation

name: operator phrases preserve quoted text
source:
Say "plus and is equal to remain text".
If 4 IS AT LEAST 4:
    Say "case-insensitive phrase".
End if.
If 2 is not in [1, 3]:
    Say "not a member".
End if.
If 2 is in [1, 2, 3]:
    Say "member".
End if.
output:
plus and is equal to remain text
case-insensitive phrase
not a member
member

name: unicode identifiers and parameters
source:
Let café be 7.
To double with valeur:
    Give back valeur times 2.
End function.
Let résumé be double(café).
Say résumé.

name: named function arguments
source:
To greet with person and greeting:
    Give back "{greeting}, {person}!".
End function.
Say greet(person="Ada", greeting="Hello").
Say greet("Grace", greeting="Welcome").

name: named constructor and method arguments
source:
Create a class called Speaker:
    When creating a Speaker with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
    To greet with greeting:
        Say "{greeting}, {this.name}!".
    End function.
End class.
Let speaker be Speaker(name="Ada").
Tell speaker to greet with "Hello".
Say speaker.greet(greeting="Welcome").

name: portable scalar rendering
source:
Say nothing.
Say true.
Say false.

name: portable division error
source: Say 10 divided by 0.

name: constants and runtime type annotations
source:
Let constant greeting as text be "Hello".
Let visits as number be 2.
Set visits to visits plus 1.
Say greeting.
Say visits.

name: class annotations accept derived instances
source:
Create a class called Parent:
End class.
Create a class called Child based on Parent:
End class.
Let value as Parent be new Child.
Say type_of(value).

name: typed assignment rejects incompatible value
source:
Let age as number be 21.
Set age to "old".

name: constant assignment is rejected
source:
Let constant answer be 42.
Set answer to 43.

name: unknown type annotation is rejected
source: Let score as imaginary_type be 10.

name: portable numeric types and nested collection rendering
source:
Say type_of(4).
Say [true, nothing, 3.0].
Say {"flag": true, "count": 3.0}.

name: statement delimiters inside strings and nested expressions
source:
Let phrase be "be and to remain text".
Set phrase to "to and be remain text".
Say phrase.
To echo with first and second:
    Give back first.
End function.
Say echo("left and middle", "right").
output:
to and be remain text
left and middle

name: otherwise-if chain
source:
Let choice be 2.
If choice is equal to 1:
    Say "one".
Otherwise if choice is equal to 2:
    Say "two".
Otherwise if choice is equal to 3:
    Say "three".
Otherwise:
    Say "other".
End if.

name: Check that assertion passes
source:
Check that 2 plus 2 is equal to 4.
Say "assertion passed".

name: Check that assertion fails
source: Check that false.

name: CSV parse and stringify with quoted text
source:
Use the csv library.
Let rows be csv.parse("name,note\nAda,\"hello, world\"\n").
Say rows[1][1].
Say csv.stringify([["name", "note"], ["Ada", "hello, world"]]).

name: CSV stringify rejects non-text cells
source:
Use the csv library.
Say csv.stringify([["answer", 42]]).

name: functional map filter and reduce with Tell functions
source:
To double with value:
    Give back value times 2.
End function.
To is_even with value:
    Give back value modulo 2 is equal to 0.
End function.
To add with total and value:
    Give back total plus value.
End function.
Say map(double, [1, 2, 3]).
Say filter(is_even, [1, 2, 3, 4]).
Say reduce(add, [1, 2, 3, 4], 0).

name: functional map preserves closures
source:
To make_adder with offset:
    To add with value:
        Give back value plus offset.
    End function.
    Give back add.
End function.
Let add_three be make_adder(3).
Say map(add_three, [1, 2]).

name: multiple assignment declares and updates names
source:
Let first, second be [10, 20].
Set first, second to [30, 40].
Say [first, second].

name: multiple assignment enforces exact arity
source:
Let first, second be [10, 20].
Set first, second to [30].

name: multiple assignment requires a list
source: Let first, second be 10.

name: function default arguments and named overrides
source:
To greet with person and greeting defaulting to "Hello":
    Give back "{greeting}, {person}!".
End function.
Say greet("Ada").
Say greet("Grace", "Welcome").
Say greet(person="Lin").
output:
Hello, Ada!
Welcome, Grace!
Hello, Lin!

name: function default can use an earlier parameter
source:
To area with width and height defaulting to width times 2:
    Give back width times height.
End function.
Say area(3).

name: function still requires parameters without defaults
source:
To combine with required and optional defaulting to 1:
    Give back required plus optional.
End function.
Say combine().

name: function defaults are evaluated at each call
source:
Let greeting be "Hello".
To greet with person and prefix defaulting to greeting:
    Give back "{prefix}, {person}!".
End function.
Say greet("Ada").
Set greeting to "Welcome".
Say greet("Grace").

name: variadic function parameter collects remaining arguments
source:
To collect with first and all remaining values as rest:
    Give back [first, rest].
End function.
Say collect(1, 2, 3).
Say collect(4).

name: default parameter can precede variadic parameter
source:
To collect with first defaulting to 1 and all remaining values as rest:
    Give back [first, rest].
End function.
Say collect().
Say collect(2, 3, 4).

name: variadic parameter cannot be supplied by name
source:
To collect with all remaining values as rest:
    Give back rest.
End function.
Say collect(rest=[1, 2]).

name: enumerate returns index value pairs
source:
Say enumerate(["a", "b"]).
Say enumerate([]).

name: for each destructures enumerated index and value
source:
For each index, value in enumerate(["a", "b"]):
    Say "{index}:{value}".
End loop.

name: for each destructuring requires matching list arity
source:
For each first, second in [[1]]:
    Say first.
End loop.

name: Tell method calls compile to expression ASTs
source:
Create a class called Greeter:
    To greet with name:
        Say "Hello, {name}!".
    End function.
End class.
Let greeter be a new Greeter.
Tell greeter to greet with "Ada".

name: instance property assignment uses parsed member target
source:
Create a class called Person:
    When creating a Person with name:
        Remember name as this.name.
    End constructor.
End class.
Let person be a new Person with "before".
Set person.name to "after".
Say person.name.

name: constructor supports default arguments
source:
Create a class called Counter:
    When creating a Counter with initial defaulting to 5:
        Remember initial as this.value.
    End constructor.
End class.
Let counter be a new Counter.
Say counter.value.
